stable.releaseNotes: Removes the local owner-editing designation requirement. A connected dashboard folder can edit when the browser has read/write access. Removes owner recovery controls and keeps existing file, update, revision, and workspace protections. No workspace migration.

beta.releaseNotes: Corrects CSI reporting freshness using verified report scope instead of survey-response dates, supports validated zero-response CSI exports through real ingestion, and prevents reimporting old CSI reports from appearing current. Adds parser-to-import and Beta package/runtime regression checks. No Workspace migration; Stable remains 0.10.17.
